subject: Money
title: Central Bank Digital Currencies
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Central Bank Digital Currencies.

hook.text: China's digital yuan has 260 million users. It's not crypto—it's government money on a digital rail the state controls.

buildup.text: 130 countries are exploring CBDCs. They want crypto's speed without losing control over monetary policy.

discovery.text: CBDCs could make payments instant, free, and universal. No bank account needed. Just a phone and an identity.

twist.text: CBDCs give governments total visibility into every transaction. Privacy advocates call them surveillance coins.

climax.text: The battle between decentralized crypto and centralized CBDCs will define digital money. Both have real trade-offs.

punchline.text: Government crypto. Same tech. Opposite philosophy.

quiz.question: How many countries are exploring CBDCs?
